entries.en: Mind taking a look at my chrome?
entries.ro: Te superi să te uiți la chrome-ul meu?

entries.en: Why don't you have any implants?
Mind takin' a look at my chrome?
entries.en_m: You mind takin' a look at my chrome?
entries.ro: Te deranjează să-mi arunci o privire la chrome-ul meu?

entries.en: You never got yourself chipped...? Kinda like having a dentist with no teeth, isn't it?
entries.en_m: You never got yourself chipped? Kinda like having a dentist with no teeth, isn't it?
entries.ro: Nu te-ai cipat niciodată? E ca un dentist fără dinți, nu?

entries.en: I have good rep. You won't hear any complaint about me.
entries.ro: Am reputație bună. N-o să auzi nicio plângere despre mine.

entries.en: Mind taking a look at my chrome?
entries.ro: Te superi să te uiți la chrome-ul meu?

entries.en: Why? Your job'd be easier with a Kiroshi implant.
entries.ro: De ce? Munca ți-ar fi mai ușoară cu un implant Kiroshi.

entries.en: But why? Job'd be a lot easier with some zoom-capable Kiroshi optics.
entries.en_m: But why? I mean, your job would be a lot easier with some zoom-capable Kiroshi optics.
entries.ro: De ce? Munca ți-ar fi mult mai ușoară cu niște optici Kiroshi cu mărire.

entries.en: I'm sure it would. Until the day this planet get hit by a massive solar flare.
entries.ro: Sigur. Până în ziua când o erupție solară uriașă lovește planeta asta.

entries.en: So why would I get Kiroshi if sooner or later I just go blind?
entries.ro: Deci de ce mi-aș lua Kiroshi dacă, mai devreme sau mai târziu, orbec?

entries.en: I'm talkin' about a geomagnetic storm that wipes out all live-circuit systems... implants included.
entries.ro: Vorbesc de o furtună geomagnetică care șterge tot ce e pe circuite vii... implanturile cu tot.

entries.en: OK... can you take a look at my chrome now?
entries.ro: Bine... te uiți acum la chrome-ul meu?

entries.en: So why'd you become a ripperdoc?
entries.ro: Deci de ce te-ai făcut ripperdoc?

entries.en: I like the job. Besides, nobody wants to hear truth anyway.
entries.ro: Îmi place treaba. Oricum, nu vrea nimeni să audă adevărul.

entries.en: If you're so paranoid, why're you chippin' other people with chrome?
entries.ro: Dacă ești atât de paranoică, de ce le bagi chrome altora?
entries.ro_m: Dacă ești atât de paranoic, de ce le bagi chrome altora?

entries.en: I want to change my appearance.

entries.en_m: I'd like to use your services.
entries.ro: Aș vrea să apelez la serviciile tale.
